body: I have one, you have one. If you remove the first letter, a bit remains. If you remove the second, bit still remains. If you remove the third, it still remains?

I have palms but not on hands, I offer foods from distant lands, When at my peak you'll see me smoke, I'm famous for my friendly folk, My flowers grow and yet they lay, There's fire where a man will play. What am I?
I have rivers without water. Forests without trees. Mountains without rocks. Towns without houses?
I have roads but no pavement, rivers but no water and cities but no buildings. What am I?
I have roots nobody sees. I am taller than trees. Up, up I go but I never grow. What am I?
I have seas without water. I have forests without wood. I have deserts without sand. I have houses with no bricks?
I have six faces but not even one body connected, eyes in total but cannot see. What am I?
I have split the one into five. I am the circle that few will spy. I am the path that breaks and gives. I am the bow no man may bend?
I have strong affection for belly buttons. What am I?
I have thirteen hearts but no body or soul. What am I?
I have three eyes and only one leg. Obey me or you will be sorry. What am I?
I have three feet but no arms or legs. What am I?
I have three heads. Cut off one, I become stronger. Cut off two, I become ten. What am I?
I have to be broken before I can be used. What am I?
I have to be opened but I don’t have a lid or a key to get in. What am I?
I have two arms but fingers none. I have two feet but cannot run. I carry well but I have found I carry best with my feet off the ground. What am I?
I have two bodies but I am joined into one. I sit still but when flipped I run. What am I?
I have two bodies joined together as one. When standing still. I ran and ran. What am I?
I have two eyes in the front and a lot of eyes on my tail. What am I?
I have two hands but cannot clap?
I have two heads but only one body. The stiller I stand, the faster I run. What am I?
I have two legs but they only touch the ground while I'm at rest. What am I?
I have wheels and flies, yet I am not an aircraft. What am I?
I have wings and I have a tail, across the sky is where I sail. Yet I have no eyes, ears or mouth and I bob randomly from north to south. What am I?
I have wings, I am able to fly, I’m not a bird yet I soar high in the sky. What am I?
I have wings. I am able to fly. I'm not a bird, yet I soar high in the sky. What am I?

I heard of a wonder, of words moth-eaten. That is a strange thing, I thought, weird. That a man's song be swallowed by a worm. His blinded sentences, his bedside stand-by rustled in the night - and the robber-guest. Not one wit the wiser. For the words he had mumbled?
I help boats park. What am I?
I help engines spin and pants stay up. What am I?
I help to mature your spirits. When moistened I fulfill my purpose. Should I dry out, my task will fail And my quarry may be worthless?
I help you carry your books. What am I?
I hide but my head is outside?
I hide but my head is outside. What am I?
I hide in a dark tunnel awaiting my time. I can only be released by pulling back. Once released, I may do unstoppable damage. What am I?
I hide my treasure in the ground, my tail is big and fluffy. If you spot me in a tree, please don’t call me scruffy. What am I?
I hold two meanings. With one I may be broken, with the other I hold on. What am I?
I hold two people together but touch only one. What am I?
I hop around and deliver eggs at Easter. What am I?
I increase head turning rate tremendously for girls at beaches. What am I?
I invade your home once a year.. but only if you've been good. What am I?
I jump when I walk and I sit where I stand. What am I?
I jump when I walk and sit when I stand. What am I?
I keep things green and keep kids happy during summer time. What am I?
I know a word of letters three, Add two and fewer there will be?
I know a word of letters three. Add two and fewer there will be?
I know a word of letters three. Add two and fewer there will be. What is the word?
I know a word of three letters. Add two and fewer there will be. What is it?
I known a word of letters three. Add two and fewer there will be?

I lack much reason but often rhyme and require logic to pass the time, To get the words to tell your kin, Look for clues that lie within, Though all are different, they act the same, The answer is practically in the name?
I let water fall on you while everyone else stays dry. What am I?
